notice: SECONDARY, descriptive: not a confirmatory analysis (ANALYSIS_PLAN §7.1 lists only H2 and H2b for RQ2)

rows.choice: The registered run of the stage ttt (20261013-121926-E2-ttt-92bd5f): the three representatives, 100 solver seeds each, three calibration instances of N = 200 (seeds 1014, 1043, 1049), the common start, 60 s.

time.choice: End-to-end time (t0 of the common start included) of the first ĝ <= τ on the trajectory, τ = 1e-3 and 1e-4 (sensitivity), against the reference of the instance: the certified optimum of the calibration screening (reference_table over the certificates and the rows).

curve.choice: A run that misses the target is censored at the budget and stays in the denominator: the points are (t_(i), (i - 1/2)/n) over the runs that got there, n all the runs of the method.
curve.why: §12 of 2026-10-17, TTT curves (3); Aiex, Resende & Ribeiro (2007).

summaries.choice: Per method and instance: the share at the target, the Kaplan-Meier quartiles (None beyond the budget); per pair, P(TTT_A < TTT_B) over all pairs of runs (a tie counts 1/2, a censored run loses to one that got there, two censored runs tie).

degenerate.choice: A start that already meets the target makes every time t0: the instance is reported as degenerate at that τ (the numbers are kept, flagged).

status.choice: Descriptive: no test, no interval, no pooling over the instances.
